name: Toyota Parts Distribution Center - Ontario CA

fieldNotes.facilityType: Toyota North American Parts Center (NAPDC), Toyota's largest US parts distribution facility — ~817,000 sf Class A warehouse at 1425 Toyota Way, Ontario CA (Inland Empire). Stocks 185,000-260,000+ unique service parts; ships ~65,000 order lines/day; an FTZ site.
fieldNotes.buildingIdentification: Resolved to the large white-roof tilt-up warehouse running E-W between Toyota Way (north frontage / employee parking) and the CA-60 freeway (south). The building's scale (~800K sf single mass), modern construction, and the Toyota Way street name match the NAPDC. The roster's APPROXIMATE city-level point sits at this building. Cannot 100% confirm this exact footprint is parcel 1425 vs an immediate neighbor — flagged.
fieldNotes.truckGate: The south truck yard / dock apron and drop yard are fenced off from the CA-60 frontage road. Truck access is via a controlled gate at the SE end of the property. A large modern OEM parts DC of this profile operates a controlled truck gate.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No discrete guard booth was isolated in imagery. Modern Inland Empire DCs of this type commonly run a controlled gate with kiosk / badge / app check-in rather than a staffed booth — classified guardShack false / remoteGs true, but flagged uncertain (a small booth could exist at the SE gate).
fieldNotes.remoteGs: True (inferred) — gate present, no confirmed staffed booth.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: The building's full south face is one continuous dock bank — a regular rhythm of ~70 dock doors with trailers backed in across most of them. Banded 50+.
fieldNotes.dropArea: A large fenced drop yard along the south side parallel to the dock apron holds ~70 parked trailers in striped rows; capacity ~110. Banded 50+.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Deep paved apron between the dock face and the drop yard gives interior queue/staging room (drivewayLong true).
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: All dock activity is on the single south face — shipping and receiving are not on physically separate building faces. False.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property — the building fronts the CA-60 freeway, not a rail line. False.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: Wide paved truck apron and drop-yard lanes give ample room for an express/bypass lane at the gate.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: Perimeter box ~42 acres for the building + south truck yard / drop yard; flagged approximate.

citations.claim: North American Parts Center California (NAPCC) in Ontario CA ships 280,000+ pieces/day across 260,000+ unique part numbers

verification.rationale: Toyota largest US parts procurement/distribution center (NAPCC) at Ontario CA confirmed operating; 2026 locator corroborates; no closure signal.
